title: La Junta de Guadalajara, VISTA STORIES
comment: junta-guadalajara (VISTA): sala de juntas de una casa tequilera en Guadalajara. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ERNESTO_VALDIVIA: Mexican tequila company owner from Jalisco, 60 years old, heavy-set, light skin, slicked-back grey hair, a grey goatee, a dark-navy pinstripe suit, a white shirt with no tie, a gold signet ring, black shoes, his hands empty.
chars.LUCIA_MENDEZ: Mexican businesswoman, 40 years old, light-brown skin, sleek straight black hair to the shoulders, discreet makeup, small diamond earrings, a tailored ivory pantsuit, a black silk blouse, black heels, her hands empty.
chars.MAURICIO_VALDIVIA: Mexican man, 32 years old, fair skin, styled short black hair with a quiff, clean-shaven, a slim light-grey suit, a pink shirt open at the collar, white sneakers, his hands empty.
chars.BEATRIZ_VALDIVIA: Mexican woman, 58 years old, fair skin, short elegant light-brown bob haircut, pearl earrings, a camel wool coat over a black turtleneck dress, a structured black handbag on her arm, black heels.

locs.LOC_JUNTAGUADALAJARA: Modern boardroom on the top floor of a tequila company in Guadalajara, Jalisco, in the morning: glass walls, a long dark wood conference table with leather chairs, a decorative blue agave plant in a big clay pot, shelves with unlabeled tequila bottles, a wide window with the city view, a glass door, soft light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
